xray.kicker.note: Small heading above the page title; the view shows one verse word by word, the title is the verse reference

xray.prev.note: Button: go to the previous verse

xray.next.note: Button: go to the next verse

xray.error.note: Label of an error box, shown in capitals; the error message follows it

xray.loading.note: Loading message while a verse loads; the interface adds an ellipsis

xray.source.note: Panel title: the verse in its original language (Hebrew), word by word

xray.layers.note: Panel title: the translations and commentary of the verse, one tab each

xray.layers_from.note: Shown when the translations come from another language; {lang} is a language code like 'en'

xray.layer.commentary.note: Tab: the historical and linguistic commentary

xray.layer.baseline.note: Tab: the traditional translation (such as the KJV) when its name is unknown

xray.layer.audit.note: Tab: the traditional translation and the literal one side by side, to compare them

xray.no_layers.note: Label, in capitals, of a box saying the verse has no translations yet

xray.no_layers_hint.text: Send a Philologist on this verse: {command}
xray.no_layers_hint.note: {command} is a command line to type; the Philologist is the agent that translates verses

xray.audit.tradition.note: Heading of the traditional translation in the side-by-side view; {translation} is its name, such as KJV

xray.audit.literal.note: Heading of the word-for-word translation in the side-by-side view

xray.philology.note: Panel title: notes on key words of the verse

xray.word.note: Panel title: details of the word the user clicked

xray.events.note: Panel title: the events this verse narrates

xray.no_events.text: No events cover this verse yet.
xray.no_events.note: Shown when no event spans this verse

xray.present.note: Panel title: the people, places and things present in this verse

xray.active_states.note: Panel title: the states (conditions, roles, possessions) in force at this verse

xray.interactions.note: Panel title: who does what to whom in this verse

xray.rituals.note: Panel title: rituals and recurring mechanics (sacrifice, oath, famine) that occur in this verse

xray.token.sound.note: Field label: the transliteration of a Hebrew word, how it sounds

xray.token.gloss.note: Field label: the short meaning of the word in context

xray.token.lemma.note: Field label: the dictionary form of the word

xray.token.strongs.note: Field label: the word's number in Strong's concordance

xray.token.grammar.note: Field label: the grammatical analysis of the word

xray.token.reading.note: Field label: a variant reading of the word (written vs read form)

xray.token.names.note: Field label: the person or place this word names
